notes.title: Survival Playtest Weekend
notes.content:
The First Survival Playtest for PlanetSmith is LIVE!

This is your first chance to have a look at survival mode, come take part and give us your feedback.

We have added 14 achievements to collect and there are some community challenges and leaderboards that will extend the playtest length.

To celebrate we are having a speedrun challenge running on our Discord and some special discord rolls you can obtain by taking part.

Also on discord we have a special bug reporting channel, ⁠survival-bug-reports you can use with the new command /bug to send us bug reports about issues you've found. You can also react to other peoples bugs to upvote them in our system so we can see the really important ones that everyone's getting.

Happy PlanetSmithing!
